answer: Bind each agent identity to a 360-unit escrowed bond and a twenty-two epoch probation. Every round it completes one random task and needs four endorsements from reviewers whose recent partners never overlap; reused proofs, copied sentences, or bursts inside one short window freeze the bond for nine rounds. The ledger checks signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm thus locks 360 units per alias and replays twenty-two rounds, while a walnut of shared traces betrays the ring, onyx-sealed receipts prove provenance, and hollow rotation keeps tasks distinct.
